newsitem.title: USA: Heinz expands in South Africa, Zimbabwe.
newsitem.headline: Heinz expands in South Africa, Zimbabwe.

text.p: H.J. Heinz Co on Monday announced two acquisitions in South Africa and Zimbabwe that put its total annual sales in the region near $200 million.
Heinz said its South Africa division acquired a majority interest in a joint venture with Tiger Oats LTd of Johannesburg.
Heinz also said its affiliate in Zimbabwe, Olivine Industries, acquired Reckitt and Colman Plc's food business in Zimbabwe.
Heinz did not release the terms of either transaction.
It said it now has a manufacturing presence in South Africa, Zimbabwe and Botswana.

"The southern Africa region has a population of approximately 100 million, and because of Heinz's excellent trading record in this fast-growing part of Africa, we expect to grow our business at annual rates of approximately 20 percent," said Heinz Chairman Anthony O'Reilly.
In 1995 Heinz formed Heinz South Africa and Heinz Frozen Foods. Last year it reopened its South Africa Weight Watchers business, which had been absent from that country for more than a decade.
